cases.name: import-typed-word
cases.expected: A versioned WIT function import generates a statically typed Noble word with ordered parameters/results and a conservative WitOpId effect.

cases.name: reject-export-mismatch
cases.expected: A Noble export whose closed stack interface cannot match the selected WIT function is rejected before component emission.

cases.name: lossless-type-mapping
cases.expected: Boundary conversion preserves exact WIT type distinctions; a lossy implicit narrowing is rejected.

cases.name: owned-resource-move-only
cases.expected: An owned WIT resource cannot be duped, quoted, or generically serialized and transfers ownership exactly once.

cases.name: borrow-resource-no-escape
cases.expected: A borrowed WIT resource cannot escape its declared adapter/borrow scope.

cases.name: forged-handle-rejected
cases.expected: A forged, stale, wrong-type, or wrong-context resource handle is rejected at the boundary.

cases.name: wit-import-effect
cases.expected: An imported WIT function is not inferred pure solely from its WIT signature.

cases.name: effect-not-authority
cases.expected: A program with the correct WIT effect/import contract is denied when the linked host/profile does not grant the required authority.

cases.name: world-build-identity
cases.expected: Changing a versioned WIT world/interface input changes the build context and is not treated as an invisible linker substitution.

cases.name: program-not-raw-wit
cases.expected: Program<S,T,e> cannot be exported as a raw address or unspecified generic WIT function handle.

cases.name: wasi03-async-order
cases.expected: A native async WIT call may suspend but later sequential Noble words do not begin early or reorder.

cases.name: stream-future-cleanup
cases.expected: stream<T>/future<T> boundary values preserve typed completion/cancellation/resource cleanup rules.

cases.name: wasi02-explicit-compat
cases.expected: A WASI 0.2 component is accepted only through the explicit compatibility profile, not silently as 0.3.

cases.name: preserves-not-capability
cases.expected: A Preserves payload cannot become a live WIT/Noble resource or capability without an explicit validated adapter.

cases.name: cross-language-component
cases.expected: A Noble component interoperates through its WIT world with an independently generated Component Model peer.
